up: Retrieve the first 1000 rows of activity data for target CHEMBL4187. Output columns: assay ChEMBL ID (from assays), target type (from target_dictionary), tax_id (from target_dictionary), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), standard type (from activities), and pChEMBL value (from activities). Join tables: activities, assays (on assay_id), target_dictionary (on tid), molecule_dictionary (on molregno), and compound_structures (on molregno). Apply filters: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4187', activities.standard_relation = '=', and activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID, then assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT assays.chembl_id, target_dictionary.target_type, target_dictionary.tax_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, activities.standard_type, activities.pchembl_value FROM activities JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4187' AND activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, assays.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
